platform.cpu: 12th Gen Intel Core i9-12900H, 14 cores / 20 logical processors
platform.limitations: desktop software, not flight hardware, not network or secure-erasure timing

state.scope: finite numerical state abstraction, not ProVerif or unbounded machine proof

simulation_assumptions.model: independent candidate availability and packet losses; fresh bundle per episode; online fallback
simulation_assumptions.omits: orbital traces, link budgets, Doppler, correlated outages, scheduling and competing queues
simulation_assumptions.control_bits: sum over transmissions on both hops; excludes application payload and return traffic
simulation_assumptions.return_loss: one exogenous protected-return opportunity per attempt
simulation_assumptions.availability: fallback assumes a reachable access satellite and GW; active jamming has no finite bound

gateway_prepare_measurement.authenticated_input: PREFIX || satellite-down || N_R || CT_Sj || CT_R || tag_R
gateway_prepare_measurement.limitations: desktop batch throughput, not flight hardware or network latency

measurement_scope: Only gateway_prepare entries use the separate gateway_prepare_measurement platform. Other benchmark components and synthetic data retain the original platform and results.
